labels.label: cor:model_minimal
labels.notes: model_minimal (ModelRowsE0.lean:117) proves, for every alpha > 0, (massive alpha).CausallyArcConnected and AbsolutelyMinimal (strict, reused), and at kappa = 0 E0.causality.CausallyArcConnected, AbsolutelyMinimal and AbsolutelyMinimalOn W for every open W. That is the printed statement (l.1386) for every kappa >= 0 (alpha = 2*pi is E^{1,2}), plus the proof's premise. It adds no hypothesis. The only gap is the OQ-34/OQ-35 reading of E_0. It is disclosed in SCOPE (a), and the row is partial and unmarked.

labels.label: rem:pushup
labels.notes: pushup (l.136) proves PushUp (defi:pushup: every open U and every x, future and past, both inclusions of l.1377) and PushUpOn W for every open W, for E_alpha and E_0. That covers 'equivalently ... and symmetrically in the past' and 'in every open subset' (l.1376-1379). The first sentence (l.1375-1376) is refuted at E_0 by pushup_concat_counterexample (l.172). I checked the counterexample. c1 = axisLine (0,0) on [-1,0] is a DEC-6 future causal curve (E0.axis_causalCurveOn). c2 is a ChronalCurveOn top on [0,1] from (0,0), and one exists by causal arc-connectedness and Z+ = E_0. c1 0 = c2 0. The glued map 'if t <= 0 then c1 t else c2 t' is exactly CurveOn.concat (Curves.lean:154) of the two curves for C.le, with c2 weakened to causal, so it is a DEC-6 causal curve. It is not chronal: lt_of_lt at -1 < 0 would give (-1,0) << (0,0), and I^-_W of an axis point is empty (E0.not_lt_of_mem_axis). The pieces come in the printed order, causal and then chronological. The refutation does not depend on OQ-34: it uses only what defi:causal_E0 itself prints (the singular line is locally causal and not locally chronal, and I^-(p) is empty, l.1345-1347). Classification: this is a statement-level wording error, not a misprint and not an open reading. The printed sentence is unambiguous and false, already for kappa > 0 (curation findings_triage, kind 'sentence', WP-9). The intended content is the push-up of the 'Equivalently' clause, which is proved. Marking a reworded form later would need a DEC row (kb 0022), on top of OQ-34/35. The row is partial and unmarked.

labels.label: lem:IJ_calc
labels.notes: IJ_calc (l.209) states, for every p, interior (J+_top {p}) ∩ Zminus = I+_top {p} and interior (J-_top {p}) ∩ Zplus = I-_top {p}, for Massive alpha (alpha > 0) and for E0. That is l.1443 as printed. I^±, J^± and Z^∓ are read globally (U = top, with Zplus and Zminus as in Properties.lean:137-140, def:strongly_tarentin_point), and BTZ points are included. e0_IJ_calc_reg adds the form after substituting Z+ = E_0 and Z- = E_0 \ axis (the proof's first paragraph). The row is partial only for the E_0 reading.

labels.label: lem:densite_modele
labels.notes: densite_modele (l.328), for kappa > 0: (a) and (b) at every p, and both in every V. (c) is stated only for kappa = 0, so it is correctly absent here. For kappa = 0 (e0_densite): (a) at every p, BTZ points included; (b) for p not on the axis (p in reg(E_0)); (c) for p on the axis (sing(E_0) = E0.axis = singE0 0). The same three hold in every V : Opens E0 with CausallyConvexIn V top, which is defi:convexite_causale with U = M and the diamond J-_top(q) ∩ J+_top(p). In V, J and I are J±_V {p} and I±_V {p}, and the closure is closure(.) ∩ V. That equals the subspace closure in V of a subset of V, and it is the only reading under which the V clause can hold, since the closure in E_kappa leaves V. The reading is disclosed in SCOPE (b). I checked that the V clauses are not vacuous. e0_exists_causallyConvexIn_axis gives an open V that is causally convex in top, contains the BTZ point (0,0) and a regular point, and lies inside ball((0,0),1), so V is not univ: (5,0) is outside. Every one of (a), (b), (c) therefore has an instance in a proper V. The V comes from e0_stronglyCausalOpen and its convexity is kernel-checked. No hypothesis is added. The row is partial for the E_0 reading and the V-closure reading.

labels.label: rem:galileo_spacetime_not_strongly
labels.notes: Only the last sentence (l.672-673) is delivered. models_stronglyCausal (l.447) proves StronglyCausal and StronglyCausalOpen (the two readings, OQ-8 and DEC-7) for every E_alpha, alpha > 0, and for E0. e0_stronglyCausalOpen is new and duplicates nothing in the strict library: grep finds no E0 StronglyCausalOpen in Causal/. The reading of 'the flat model spacetimes of Section subsec:sing_spacetime_defi' as the model spaces E_kappa, rather than the E_{>=0}-manifolds of the same section (the label sits after \section{Singular flat spacetimes}, l.1319-1320), is the sensible one. It is disclosed in SCOPE (c) and in a question, and the row is partial. The Galileo sentences stay strict and are untouched.

findings.what: The finding itself is true and proof-level. lem:IJ_calc needs no condition on p. As printed, the J- case admits BTZ points (p in Z+ = E_0), where J-(p) ≠ closure I-(p) = ∅, while statement (b) excludes them. But replacing Z^∓ by Z^± is not a misprint correction, and the master's wave note calls it 'Z^∓→Z^± misprint'. The printed Z^∓ fits the rest of the paragraph: l.1488 'covers (a) for κ>0 and for p ∈ reg(E_0)' is exactly what Z^∓ gives for the + case (Z- = reg), and l.1488-1491 exist only because Z^∓ leaves out (a) at BTZ points. Moving to Z^± is a rewrite of the (editorial, '-- verify') proof: change l.1482, change l.1488, delete l.1488-1491, and restrict the cited fact of l.1481. It is a suggestion for the author, not a typo.

findings.where: REPORT.json lem:densite_modele finding 4 ('at κ = 0 the citation is not needed either')
findings.what: The claim is overstated. The cited fact ('J^±(p) is the closure of its interior') is indeed not needed. But the replacement uses the closedness of J^±(p) (E0.isClosed_Jplus, E0.isClosed_Jminus, ported model facts). The paper states closedness nowhere, and it would come from the same explicit description of the cones in [brunswic2021cauchy, §1.2]. Sent as written, the finding tells the author he can drop a reference that he would still need for closedness.
findings.fix: Reword at graduation to: 'the closure-of-interior fact is not needed at κ = 0: push-up, Z+ = E_0, Z- = reg(E_0) and the closedness of J^±(p) suffice (for (b), with the axis step via E0.lt_axis_iff)'. Keep it an observation, not an error.

findings.what: The finding is true and proof-level. The Lean witness is proved in the OQ-34 reading, but the finding does not depend on it: the paper's own defi:causal_E0 (l.1347) gives J-(p) = {r = 0, τ ≤ τ(p)} at a BTZ point. That half-line has empty interior in the 3-manifold, so the closure of its interior is empty, while p ∈ J-(p). The l.1481 'for every p' contradicts the paper's own l.1347 whatever OQ-34 rules. The REPORT does not say so.
findings.fix: At graduation, add to the curated finding: 'already contradicted by defi:causal_E0, l.1347'. The finding then stands independently of OQ-34.
